statement: The advective screening kernel reports advective clearance as the dominant contribution to total loss when residence time is short relative to half-life.

source_references.title: Fate MCP advective loss-dominance method notes
EPA Guidance on the Development, Evaluation, and Application of Environmental Models

methods_basis_lines: This claim is limited to the trace-level loss decomposition in the governed advective screening equation, where degradation and clearance shares sum to the total first-order loss term.
The claim is satisfied when advective clearance remains the larger resolved loss-share component under a short-residence and effectively persistent screening regime.
